# openaiagents_vault (Data Source)

Look up a vault by ID. Secrets are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openaiagents_vault" "shared" {
  name = "shared-mcp"
}

data "openaiagents_vault" "selected" {
  id = openaiagents_vault.shared.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Remote vault ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix create timestamp.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata map.
- `name` (String) Vault name.
- `object` (String) Object type.
